title: Synthesis and Reactivity of NHC-Based Rhodium Macrocycles
authors: Andrew, Rhiann E.; Chaplin, Adrian B.
reference: Synthesis and Reactivity of NHC-Based Rhodium Macrocycles | Andrew, Rhiann E.; Chaplin, Adrian B. | Inorganic Chemistry (2015), 54(1), 312-322
experimental_procedure: N2 was bubbled through a solution of 2a (0.100 g, 0.070 mmol) and Grubbs I (0.003 g, 0.004 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (70 mL) for 1 h. After this time, ESI-MS indicated 69% reaction conversion. A further portion of Grubbs I (0.003 g, 0.004 mmol) was added, and N2 was bubbled through for an additional hour, at which time ESI-MS indicated the reaction had gone to completion. The resulting solution was concentrated and passed through a silica pad using CH2Cl2 as the eluent. [Rh(C^N^C-C12H22)(CO)][BArF 4] as a yellow glass (cis:trans ~ 1:3). Yield: 0.096 g (95%). Data for [Rh(C^N^C-C12H22)(CO)][BArF 4]: 1H NMR (400 MHz, CD2Cl2, trans isomer only): δ 7.88 (t, 3JHH = 7.7, 1H, py), 7.70-7.75 (m, 8H, ArF), 7.55 (br, 4H, ArF), 7.50 (d, 3JHH = 7.7, 2H, py), 7.15 (d, 3JHH = 1.9, 2H, imid), 7.01 (d, 3JHH = 1.9, 2H, imid), 5.40 (br, 2H, pyCH2), 5.35-5.39 (m, 2H,CH=CH), 5.03 (br, 2H, pyCH2), 3.90-4.36 (m, 4H, N-CH2CH2), 1.14-2.24 (m, 16H, CH2). ESI-MS (CH3CN, 180 °C, 3 kV): positive ion: 534.1762 m/z, [M]+ (calcd. 534.1735).
notes: Ring-closing metathesis, incremental addition of first generation Grubbs catalyst, product obtained as a mixture of 1:3 cis:trans isomers

reference: Synthesis and Reactivity of NHC-Based Rhodium Macrocycles | Andrew, Rhiann E.; Chaplin, Adrian B. | Inorganic Chemistry (2015), 54(1), 312-322
experimental_procedure: N2 was bubbled through a solution of 2b (0.100 g, 0.074 mmol) and Grubbs I (0.003 g, 0.004 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (70 mL) for 30 min (reaction completion observed by ESI-MS). The resulting solution was concentrated to dryness and purified on silica (CH2Cl2). [Rh(CNC-C12H22)(CO)][BArF 4] (cis:-trans ~ 1:1) was obtained as a purple powder by precipitation from CH2Cl2 with excess pentane and subsequent filtration. Yield: 0.083 g (82%). Data for [Rh(CNC-C12H22)(CO)][BArF 4]: 1H NMR (400 MHz, CD2Cl2): δ 8.04 (t, 3JHH = 8.2, 1H, py), 7.70-7.75 (m, 8H, ArF), 7.56 (s, 4H, ArF), 7.48/7.49 (d, 3JHH = 2.3, 2H, imid), 7.17 (d, 3JHH = 8.1, 2H, py), 7.09/7.10 (d, 3JHH = 2.3, 2H, imid), 5.27-5.37 (m, 2H, CH=CH), 4.13-4.21 (m, 4H, N-CH2), 1.97-2.09 (m, 4H, CH2), 1.80-1.91 (m, 4H, CH2), 1.24-1.50 (m, 8H, CH2). ESI-MS (CH3CN, 180 °C, 3 kV) positive ion: 506.1422 m/z, [M]+ (calcd. 506.1422).
notes: Ring-closing metathesis, product obtained as a mixture of 1:1 cis:trans isomers
